resources.string: Sensor recovery
Recover a stuck proximity connection and test near/far readings
Proximity diagnostics
If proximity is stuck, this tool reconnects the sensor service through HeckerOS. No root access is needed. A successful service restart does not prove the sensor itself recovered.
Waiting for a proximity reading…
Proximity: %1$.2f cm · %2$s
Near
Far
Near/far changes observed: %1$d
Uncover the top of the phone, cover it, then uncover it again. The reading should switch between near and far. A steady reading alone does not mean the sensor is faulty.
Restart sensor service
Motion and light sensors will pause briefly. End any call first, and keep the top of the phone uncovered.
Manual recovery only. No background or automatic resets.
Restarting the sensor service…
Service restart verified. Test near/far changes above, then retry Face Unlock. If readings remain stuck, recovery of the sensor itself is not confirmed.
This ROM build does not provide the sensor-recovery service. Install the updated HeckerOS build; root access is not required.
This recovery is available on Pixel 4 and Pixel 4 XL with a supported running sensor service.
The service restart could not be verified. No sensor recovery is claimed. Retry the physical near/far test or inspect the built-in service status.
Recovery is already running or was requested recently. Wait 30 seconds before trying again.
Unlock the phone and end any call before restarting the sensor service.
